title: 语法 · 比较与程度｜倍数和评价边界 · 60 句
description: 同级比较、比较级修饰、最高级范围、关联变化、倍数比例及 too/enough。

items.zh: 这条小路没有看上去那么陡。
items.en: The path is not as steep as it looks.
answers: The path is not as steep as it looks.
The path isn't as steep as it looks.
items.notes: not as + 原级 + as，不能用 not as steeper。

items.zh: 我的背包和你的差不多重。
items.en: My backpack is almost as heavy as yours.
answers: My backpack is almost as heavy as yours.
items.notes: almost 限定接近程度；yours 替代 your backpack。

items.zh: 今晚观众人数是我们预想的两倍。
items.en: Tonight's audience is twice as large as we expected.
answers: Tonight's audience is twice as large as we expected.
items.notes: twice as + 原级 + as，倍数放在比较结构前。

items.zh: 她讲得和写得一样清楚。
items.en: She speaks as clearly as she writes.
answers: She speaks as clearly as she writes.
items.notes: 动词 speak 用副词 clearly 比较。

items.zh: 这份指南尽可能简单，但没有省略重要信息。
items.en: The guide is as simple as possible without omitting essential information.
answers: The guide is as simple as possible without omitting essential information.
items.notes: as ... as possible：尽可能……。

items.zh: 租来的琴没有家里的那架响亮。
items.en: The rented piano is not as loud as the one at home.
answers: The rented piano is not as loud as the one at home.
The rented piano isn't as loud as the one at home.
items.notes: 比较同类事物，the one 替代 piano。

items.zh: 我们需要和上次一样多的面粉。
items.en: We need as much flour as last time.
answers: We need as much flour as last time.
items.notes: 不可数 flour 用 as much ... as。

items.zh: 这条街有和主街一样多的咖啡馆。
items.en: This street has as many cafes as the main street.
answers: This street has as many cafes as the main street.
items.notes: 可数复数 cafes 用 as many ... as。

items.zh: 步行去码头与等公交花的时间一样长。
items.en: Walking to the pier takes as long as waiting for the bus.
answers: Walking to the pier takes as long as waiting for the bus.
items.notes: as long as 在此为时间长度比较，不是条件只要。

items.zh: 这次排练至少和正式演出一样费精力。
items.en: This rehearsal is at least as demanding as the performance itself.
answers: This rehearsal is at least as demanding as the performance itself.
items.notes: at least 限定比较下界。

items.zh: 这间教室比照片里显得宽敞得多。
items.en: The classroom is much more spacious than it appears in photographs.
answers: The classroom is much more spacious than it appears in photographs.
items.notes: much 修饰比较级，不能写 very more spacious。

items.zh: 这些脚注的字号只比正文略小。
items.en: The footnotes use a font only slightly smaller than the one used for the main text.
answers: The footnotes use a font only slightly smaller than the one used for the main text.
items.notes: only slightly 限定比较差异；the one 替代 font，保持比较对象同类。

items.zh: 与昨天相比，河里的水少得多。
items.en: There is far less water in the river than yesterday.
answers: There is far less water in the river than yesterday.
items.notes: far 修饰 less；water 不可数。

items.zh: 我们需要的椅子比最初预订的少两把。
items.en: We need two fewer chairs than we originally reserved.
answers: We need two fewer chairs than we originally reserved.
items.notes: two fewer + 可数复数，明确数量差额。

items.zh: 现在再解释一遍会更容易。
items.en: Explaining it again will be even easier now.
answers: Explaining it again will be even easier now.
items.notes: even 加强比较级，不与原级 easy 直接配用。

items.zh: 这条路线比另一条长不了多少。
items.en: This route is not much longer than the other.
answers: This route is not much longer than the other.
This route isn't much longer than the other.
items.notes: not much + 比较级表示差别不大。

items.zh: 把音量调低一点，声音反而更清楚。
items.en: The sound is clearer at a slightly lower volume.
answers: The sound is clearer at a slightly lower volume.
items.notes: slightly 修饰 lower；clearer 为主句比较。

items.zh: 这个版本比旧版容易读一些。
items.en: This version is somewhat easier to read than the old one.
answers: This version is somewhat easier to read than the old one.
items.notes: somewhat 修饰比较级，表示一定程度。

items.zh: 比起速度快，我更在意发音清晰。
items.en: Clear pronunciation matters more to me than speed.
answers: Clear pronunciation matters more to me than speed.
items.notes: more ... than 比较重要性，不是数量。

items.zh: 她回来时比离开时更有信心。
items.en: She returned more confident than when she left.
answers: She returned more confident than when she left.
items.notes: than 后可接省略的时间从句。

items.zh: 这是我在这座城吃过的最柔软的面包。
items.en: This is the softest bread I have tasted in this city.
answers: This is the softest bread I have tasted in this city.
items.notes: the + 最高级；定语从句限定经验范围。

items.zh: 四份菜单中，这一份最容易看懂。
items.en: Of the four menus, this is the easiest to understand.
answers: Of the four menus, this is the easiest to understand.
items.notes: of the four 明确比较集合。

items.zh: 她是班里最不愿抢先发言的人之一。
items.en: She is one of the least eager speakers in the class.
answers: She is one of the least eager speakers in the class.
items.notes: one of + the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

items.zh: 最便宜的票不一定是最适合我们的。
items.en: The cheapest ticket is not necessarily the most suitable for us.
answers: The cheapest ticket is not necessarily the most suitable for us.
The cheapest ticket isn't necessarily the most suitable for us.
items.notes: 两个最高级分别衡量价格与适用性。

items.zh: 登顶不是这次徒步最困难的部分。
items.en: Reaching the summit was not the hardest part of the hike.
answers: Reaching the summit was not the hardest part of the hike.
Reaching the summit wasn't the hardest part of the hike.
items.notes: 最高级须有明确范围，这里为 hike。

items.zh: 在所有参展作品里，那幅小画最引人注意。
items.en: Among all the exhibits, the small painting attracted the most attention.
answers: Among all the exhibits, the small painting attracted the most attention.
items.notes: the most 修饰不可数 attention。

items.zh: 我希望选择对邻居干扰最小的时间。
items.en: I want the time that causes the least disturbance to neighbours.
answers: I want the time that causes the least disturbance to neighbours.
items.notes: least 表不可数 disturbance 的最小程度。

items.zh: 这里的冬天通常是一年中最安静的季节。
items.en: Winter is usually the quietest season here.
answers: Winter is usually the quietest season here.
items.notes: 最高级修饰单数 season，前用 the。

items.zh: 这可能是解决分歧最不费力的办法。
items.en: This may be the least demanding way to settle the disagreement.
answers: This may be the least demanding way to settle the disagreement.
items.notes: least + 多音节形容词，表达最低程度。

items.zh: 哪位选手在最后一轮犯的错误最少？
items.en: Which player made the fewest mistakes in the final round?
answers: Which player made the fewest mistakes in the final round?
items.notes: fewest 修饰可数复数 mistakes。

items.zh: 越接近海岸，空气越潮湿。
items.en: The closer we got to the coast, the damper the air became.
answers: The closer we got to the coast, the damper the air became.
items.notes: the + 比较级 ... the + 比较级 表关联变化。

items.zh: 她讲得越具体，观众的问题就越有针对性。
items.en: The more specific she became, the more focused the questions were.
answers: The more specific she became, the more focused the questions were.
items.notes: 两端比较结构并列，不使用越多越好的空泛模板。

items.zh: 路上的行人越来越少了。
items.en: There are fewer and fewer pedestrians on the road.
answers: There are fewer and fewer pedestrians on the road.
items.notes: fewer and fewer 用于可数数量持续减少。

items.zh: 等待的队伍越来越长。
items.en: The queue is getting longer and longer.
answers: The queue is getting longer and longer.
items.notes: 比较级 + and + 比较级 表逐渐变化。

items.zh: 我读得越慢，越能注意到字句之间的联系。
items.en: The more slowly I read, the more connections I notice.
answers: The more slowly I read, the more connections I notice.
items.notes: 副词 slowly 的比较级是 more slowly。

items.zh: 这首曲子越听越有意思。
items.en: The piece becomes more interesting with each listening.
answers: The piece becomes more interesting with each listening.
items.notes: more interesting 配合 with each 表逐次变化。

items.zh: 可用选项越来越少，我们需要重新考虑目标。
items.en: With fewer options available, we need to reconsider the goal.
answers: With fewer options available, we need to reconsider the goal.
items.notes: fewer + 可数复数；with 结构交代变化背景。

items.zh: 山谷里越来越冷，我们只好穿上外套。
items.en: It grew colder in the valley, so we put on our coats.
answers: It grew colder in the valley, so we put on our coats.
items.notes: grow + 比较级表状态变化。

items.zh: 说明越含糊，执行起来就越难一致。
items.en: The vaguer the instructions, the harder consistent implementation becomes.
answers: The vaguer the instructions, the harder consistent implementation becomes.
items.notes: 前半句省略 are；比较关系为清晰度与执行难度。

items.zh: 离舞台越远，听清低声对话就越困难。
items.en: The farther you sit from the stage, the harder quiet dialogue is to hear.
answers: The farther you sit from the stage, the harder quiet dialogue is to hear.
items.notes: farther 表物理距离；后半用 harder to hear。

items.zh: 午餐的价格是早餐的三倍。
items.en: Lunch costs three times as much as breakfast.
answers: Lunch costs three times as much as breakfast.
items.notes: three times as much 表总价为三倍，不是多三倍。

items.zh: 新盘子的直径约是旧盘子的两倍。
items.en: The new plate is roughly twice the diameter of the old one.
answers: The new plate is roughly twice the diameter of the old one.
items.notes: twice the + 尺寸名词，直接表倍数。

items.zh: 这次可用的座位只有平时的一半。
items.en: Only half the usual number of seats is available this time.
answers: Only half the usual number of seats is available this time.
items.notes: half the number 指数量的一半；中心 number 单数。

items.zh: 骑车所需时间不到步行的一半。
items.en: Cycling takes less than half as long as walking.
answers: Cycling takes less than half as long as walking.
items.notes: less than half as long as 比较所需时长。

items.zh: 这条围巾比样品短四分之一。
items.en: This scarf is a quarter shorter than the sample.
answers: This scarf is a quarter shorter than the sample.
items.notes: a quarter shorter 以样品为基数减少四分之一。

items.zh: 两人份套餐没有单人份的两倍贵。
items.en: The meal for two costs less than twice as much as the single portion.
answers: The meal for two costs less than twice as much as the single portion.
items.notes: less than twice as much as 表总价不到两倍。

items.zh: 第三天收到的回复是第一天的两倍多。
items.en: More than twice as many replies arrived on day three as on day one.
answers: More than twice as many replies arrived on day three as on day one.
items.notes: as many ... as 修饰可数 replies；more than 限定倍数。

items.zh: 小包的重量只有大包的三分之一。
items.en: The small bag weighs a third as much as the large one.
answers: The small bag weighs a third as much as the large one.
items.notes: a third as much 比较重量而非包的数量。

items.zh: 这个月的捐款金额比上个月高出约百分之十。
items.en: Donations this month are about ten per cent higher than last month.
answers: Donations this month are about ten per cent higher than last month.
items.notes: ten per cent higher 表相对增幅，不是百分点。

items.zh: 这次步行距离与去年完全相同。
items.en: The walking distance is exactly the same as last year's.
answers: The walking distance is exactly the same as last year's.
items.notes: the same as，不用 the same with；exactly 加强相等。

items.zh: 这碗汤太咸，无法直接喝。
items.en: The soup is too salty to drink as it is.
answers: The soup is too salty to drink as it is.
items.notes: too ... to 表程度导致不能做。

items.zh: 这个房间足够大，可以容纳整个合唱团。
items.en: The room is large enough to hold the whole choir.
answers: The room is large enough to hold the whole choir.
items.notes: 形容词后放 enough，再接不定式。

items.zh: 我们没有足够的钱同时预订两处场地。
items.en: We do not have enough money to reserve both venues.
answers: We do not have enough money to reserve both venues.
We don't have enough money to reserve both venues.
items.notes: enough 放名词前，与 large enough 的位置区分。

items.zh: 他差一点就赶上最后一班船。
items.en: He was almost in time for the last boat.
answers: He was almost in time for the last boat.
items.notes: almost 表接近达到，此句暗示未赶上；不能等同 just in time。

items.zh: 这份文字有些正式，但还算容易理解。
items.en: The wording is rather formal but still understandable.
answers: The wording is rather formal but still understandable.
items.notes: rather 修饰形容词，表示一定程度而非比较。

items.zh: 我完全不同意把问题归咎于孩子。
items.en: I entirely disagree with blaming the child.
answers: I entirely disagree with blaming the child.
items.notes: entirely 修饰 disagree，说明反对程度。

items.zh: 这里几乎和我记忆中的一样安静。
items.en: It is nearly as quiet here as I remember.
answers: It is nearly as quiet here as I remember.
items.notes: nearly as ... as 表接近同等程度。

items.zh: 这段独奏比整首曲子的其余部分更难。
items.en: The solo is harder than the rest of the piece.
answers: The solo is harder than the rest of the piece.
items.notes: the rest 明确排除被比较部分，避免与整体自比。

items.zh: 没有什么比在终点看到家人更让她高兴。
items.en: Nothing pleased her more than seeing her family at the finish.
answers: Nothing pleased her more than seeing her family at the finish.
items.notes: 否定代词 + 比较级 表达最高程度。

items.zh: 这是一段相当长的步行，但算不上最难的一段。
items.en: It is quite a long walk, though not the most difficult one.
answers: It is quite a long walk, though not the most difficult one.
items.notes: quite a + 形容词 + 名词；不是 a quite long 的此处默认顺序。
